_modelRoutes: models.*.model supports three prefixes, mixable per role: a plain id (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5") routes through the Anthropic API and needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; "ollama:<model>" routes to a local Ollama model; "claude-sdk:<model>" (e.g. "claude-sdk:sonnet") routes through the Agent SDK, drawing from your Claude Pro/Max subscription via your local `claude` CLI login (no API key, but you must be logged in on this machine) — including the tutor role (T43), which streams via SDK session resume instead of the ai-sdk agent loop. This key is documentation only — the config loader ignores unrecognized top-level keys. See README 'Model routes' for the full writeup and current limitations.
